children: Motorola Solutions said its board approved a $2 billion increase to the company's share repurchase program.
With the newest approval, the total authorization for share repurchases is now $20 billion since July of 2011, the company said.
Under the previous $18 billion share repurchase program, about $600 million remained at the end of the second quarter of this year, the company added.
Motorola Solutions shares ended the day's regular trading session at $459.89 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company has a market capitalization of $76.62 billion, 165.49 million shares outstanding and a public float of 164.86 million shares.
